newsitem.title: UK: Croatia debut mark bond expected next week-bankers.
newsitem.headline: Croatia debut mark bond expected next week-bankers.

text.p: Croatia's first mark Eurobond is expected to be launched at the end of next week following investor presentations in Munich, Frankfurt and Zurich, bankers said on Friday.
"The roadshow ends next Wednesday and we expect the bond to be launched next Thursday or Friday," a dealer said.
Bankers away from the lead manager said the bond was expected to be for 300 million marks with a seven year maturity.
An amount of up to 500 million marks with a five-year maturity has also been mooted.
Price speculation is 85-95 basis points over the May Treuhand German government bond for a seven-year bond.
Joint lead managers for the transaction are Credit Suisse First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Croatia's (the former Yugoslav republic) sovereign debt is rated Baa3 by Moody's Investor Service and BBB- by Standard & Poor's and IBCA.
Croatia made its debut on the Eurobond market in February this year with a $300 million five-year bond, which paid a seven percent coupon, or 80 basis points more than U.S. Treasury notes.
The bond was trading at around 100 b.p. over on Friday, dealers said.
